assignments.approach: Firebrand approach (sim stink-audit): do NOT open from the official timeline. assignments.name: Nia Rook
assignments.approach: Recap approach (UNDOCKED show beat): open on the CITY watching, not the cockpit. Pick 1-2 bag modes and hold them. The typed episode facts are the spine — credits, systems, combat, mishaps, magnitude — but lead with what it MEANS for who's up and who's down, never with the numbers. The pilot's packet interview is the only place their voice comes from. End on the one sentence the hallway will argue about tomorrow. This is the desk that's allowed to have fun.
